note: Pikmin (GPIE01_01, USA Rev 1) game functions, all compiled by GC/1.2.5n as C++ (-lang=c++), 38 of them member functions. headers:[] because every unit includes its own header set: each row's prependC is its unit's leading #include block, verbatim, plus the file-scope declarations and definitions the function uses from its own unit, copied in unit order (a static datum such as gmWin.cpp's `font`, and a callee the compiler inlined, such as SearchBuffer::getIndex before SearchBuffer::insert). The include paths and defines are the unit's own build.ninja words, identical for all 35 units. No row carries m2cCtx or ctx: m2c's context parser reads C only and fails on a C++ unit's context, and its ppc-mwcc-c++ target reads the class and the implicit this from the mangled symbol. asmlift reads the linked main.elf's symbol table, names and sizes only (the matching build carries no DWARF), so neither tool is given a class layout. No row carries proto.
